Because the fact is not supplied by the cited dependency, step 1.3 (which invokes [L6] to choose radii $r_i$) is left without a valid license from the declared dependencies. This is a citation of an item for a claim it does not make, and a logical gap in the proof.

Replace the citation with the item that actually defines the standard topology on $\mathbb{R}$ (or proves that it is generated by open intervals). The simplest fix is to cite the correct definition or lemma that states the interval property directly, so that [L6] becomes a properly supported fact.
